recipeCards.title: Sunday Tomato Stew
recipeCards.flavorText: Simmered slow, just like Sunday mornings.

steps: Sauté the onion and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt, pepper, and torn basil.
Serve warm with crusty bread.

recipeCards.title: Lemon Squeeze
recipeCards.flavorText: Bright, simple, and good with warm bread.

steps: Juice the lemons.
Stir the juice with sugar and water until dissolved.
Pour over ice and serve cold.

recipeCards.title: Herb Garden Salad
recipeCards.flavorText: A handful of green, fresh off the sill.

ingredients: A handful of fresh herbs (parsley, dill, chives)
steps: Toss the greens and herbs together.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, and salt for the dressing.
Drizzle over the salad just before serving.

recipeCards.title: Classic Tomato Soup
recipeCards.flavorText: Smooth, simple, and best with a full spoon.

steps: Simmer tomatoes, broth, and onion together for 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth.
Stir in butter and a splash of cream.
Season to taste and serve hot.

recipeCards.title: Lemon Roast Chicken
recipeCards.flavorText: Bright, golden, and worth the wait.

steps: Rub the chicken all over with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Stuff the cavity with the lemon, garlic, and rosemary.
Roast at 400°F (200°C) until golden, about 1 hour.
Rest for 10 minutes before carving.

recipeCards.title: Herb Hearth Focaccia
recipeCards.flavorText: Torn warm at the table, before it cools.

steps: Mix flour, yeast, water, and olive oil into a soft dough.
Let rise until doubled, about an hour.
Press into a pan, dimple with your fingers, and top with rosemary and salt.
Bake at 425°F (220°C) until golden.

recipeCards.title: Garlic Bread Basket
recipeCards.flavorText: Warm enough to fog up the window.

steps: Mix the softened butter with garlic and parsley.
Spread generously over sliced bread.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) until golden and fragrant.

recipeCards.title: Hearty Chili Pot
recipeCards.flavorText: The kind that simmers all afternoon.

ingredients: 1 lb ground meat or 2 cans beans
steps: Brown the meat or beans with onion and garlic.
Add the tomatoes, chili, and cumin.
Simmer low and slow for at least an hour, stirring occasionally.

recipeCards.title: Wooden Spoon Pancakes
recipeCards.flavorText: Stacked high on a slow Saturday.

steps: Whisk the dry ingredients together.
Stir in the milk, eggs, and melted butter until just combined.
Cook spoonfuls on a hot griddle until bubbles form, then flip.

recipeCards.title: Chili Lemon Soup
recipeCards.flavorText: A little heat, a little brightness.

steps: Simmer the broth with garlic and chili until fragrant.
Stir in the lemon juice just before serving.
Garnish with fresh herbs.

recipeCards.title: Garlic Herb Roast
recipeCards.flavorText: Sunday dinner, any day of the week.

steps: Rub the roast all over with olive oil, garlic, and herbs.
Season generously with salt and pepper.
Roast slow until tender, then rest before serving.

recipeCards.title: Grandma's Recipe Box
recipeCards.flavorText: The one that started it all.

ingredients: A little of everything you've learned so far
steps: There's no real recipe here — just years of Sunday mornings, borrowed spoons, and a box too full to close.
Some things are better remembered than measured.

recipeCards.title: Basil Breakfast Eggs
recipeCards.flavorText: Soft morning eggs with a bright basil finish.

ingredients: A handful of fresh basil, torn
steps: Whisk the eggs with milk, salt, and pepper.
Melt butter in a pan over low heat and pour in the eggs.
Stir gently until just set, then fold in the basil.
Serve right away, still soft.

recipeCards.title: Basil Butter Gnocchi
recipeCards.flavorText: Pillowy gnocchi tucked into a buttery basil glow.

ingredients: A handful of fresh basil, torn
steps: Boil the gnocchi until they float, then drain.
Melt the butter in a pan and cook the garlic until fragrant.
Toss the gnocchi in the butter until lightly golden.
Stir in the basil and top with parmesan before serving.

recipeCards.title: Basil Cream Pasta
recipeCards.flavorText: Creamy ribbons of pasta with a garden-fresh basil finish.

ingredients: A handful of fresh basil, chopped
steps: Cook the pasta until al dente, then drain, saving a little pasta water.
Simmer the garlic and cream together until slightly thickened.
Toss in the pasta, basil, and parmesan, loosening with pasta water as needed.
Season to taste and serve warm.

recipeCards.title: Chili Bean Bake
recipeCards.flavorText: A cozy bake with smoky chili warmth and hearty beans.

steps: Stir the beans, tomatoes, onion, chili, and cumin together in a baking dish.
Top with the shredded cheese.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) until bubbling and golden, about 25 minutes.

recipeCards.title: Chili Cheddar Bake
recipeCards.flavorText: Golden cheddar comfort with a little red-pepper kick.

steps: Whisk the eggs, milk, and flour together until smooth.
Stir in the cheddar and chili.
Pour into a greased baking dish and bake at 375°F (190°C) until golden and set, about 30 minutes.

recipeCards.title: Chili Cornbread Skillet
recipeCards.flavorText: Sweet skillet cornbread with a spicy chili sparkle.

steps: Whisk the buttermilk, eggs, and melted butter together, then fold in the cornmeal, flour, baking soda, and chili.
Pour into a hot, buttered skillet.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) until golden and a toothpick comes out clean, about 20 minutes.
Drizzle with honey before serving.

recipeCards.title: Chili Honey Carrots
recipeCards.flavorText: Honey-glazed carrots with a sweet little heat.

steps: Toss the carrots with olive oil and roast at 400°F (200°C) until tender, about 25 minutes.
Melt the butter and honey together with the chili.
Toss the warm carrots in the glaze and season with salt.

recipeCards.title: Chili Roast Potatoes
recipeCards.flavorText: Crisp roast potatoes with a smoky chili edge.

steps: Toss the potatoes with olive oil, chili, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Spread on a baking sheet in a single layer.
Roast at 425°F (220°C) until crisp and golden, turning once, about 35 minutes.

recipeCards.title: Garden Herb Omelet
recipeCards.flavorText: A folded omelet full of soft herbs and sunny comfort.

ingredients: A handful of mixed fresh herbs, chopped
steps: Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a pan and pour in the eggs.
Sprinkle the herbs and cheese over one half as the eggs set.
Fold in half and slide onto a plate.

recipeCards.title: Garlic Braised Greens
recipeCards.flavorText: Silky greens cooked down with mellow garlic.

ingredients: 1 bunch leafy greens (chard, kale, or spinach)
Salt and a pinch of chili flakes
steps: Warm the olive oil and cook the garlic until just golden.
Add the greens and broth, cover, and cook until wilted and tender.
Season with salt and a pinch of chili flakes.

recipeCards.title: Garlic Herb Rice
recipeCards.flavorText: Fluffy rice with roasted garlic tucked between the grains.

ingredients: A handful of fresh herbs, chopped
steps: Cook the garlic in butter until fragrant.
Stir in the rice to coat, then add the broth.
Simmer covered until the rice is tender, about 18 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and stir in the fresh herbs.

recipeCards.title: Garlic Skillet Mushrooms
recipeCards.flavorText: Savory browned mushrooms with skillet-deep flavor.

ingredients: A splash of white wine or broth
steps: Melt the butter in a hot skillet and add the mushrooms in a single layer.
Cook undisturbed until browned, then stir and add the garlic.
Deglaze with a splash of wine or broth.
Season and finish with parsley.

recipeCards.title: Garlic Tomato Bruschetta
recipeCards.flavorText: Toasty bread piled high with juicy tomato and garlic.

steps: Toast the bread slices until golden.
Rub each slice with a raw garlic clove.
Toss the tomatoes with olive oil, basil, and salt.
Spoon over the toasted bread and serve right away.

recipeCards.title: Herb Crumb Chicken
recipeCards.flavorText: Crisp herb crust over tender golden chicken.

ingredients: A handful of fresh herbs, chopped
steps: Mix the breadcrumbs with the herbs, salt, and pepper.
Dip each chicken breast in the egg, then press into the crumb mixture.
Pan-fry in olive oil until golden, then finish in a 375°F (190°C) oven until it reaches 165°F internally and juices run clear.

recipeCards.title: Herb Garden Flatbread
recipeCards.flavorText: A simple flatbread carrying the whole herb garden.

ingredients: A handful of fresh herbs, chopped
steps: Mix the flour, baking powder, salt, herbs, water, and olive oil into a soft dough.
Divide and roll into thin rounds.
Cook in a hot, dry skillet until bubbled and lightly charred on both sides.

recipeCards.title: Herb Market Soup
recipeCards.flavorText: Fresh green soup that feels straight from the market stall.

ingredients: A big handful of mixed fresh herbs
steps: Sauté the onion in olive oil until soft.
Add the potatoes and broth and simmer until tender.
Stir in the fresh herbs and blend until smooth.
Season to taste and serve warm.

recipeCards.title: Herb Roasted Carrots
recipeCards.flavorText: Roasted carrots with a sweet edge and fresh herb finish.

ingredients: A handful of fresh herbs, chopped
steps: Toss the carrots with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Roast at 400°F (200°C) until tender and lightly browned, about 25 minutes.
Drizzle with honey and scatter with fresh herbs before serving.

recipeCards.title: Lemon Apron Cookies
recipeCards.flavorText: Bright iced cookies for the happiest kitchen afternoon.

steps: Cream the butter and sugar, then mix in the lemon zest and flour.
Roll into small balls, flatten slightly, and bake at 350°F (175°C) until just set, about 12 minutes.
Whisk powdered sugar with lemon juice for the icing and drizzle over the cooled cookies.

recipeCards.title: Lemon Cream Scones
recipeCards.flavorText: Tender scones with a soft citrus cream drizzle.

steps: Mix the flour, sugar, baking powder, and lemon zest.
Cut in the cold butter until crumbly, then stir in the cream just until combined.
Shape into a round, cut into wedges, and bake at 400°F (200°C) until golden, about 18 minutes.

recipeCards.title: Lemon Herb Couscous
recipeCards.flavorText: Tiny golden grains brightened with lemon and herbs.

ingredients: A handful of fresh herbs, chopped
steps: Pour the hot broth over the couscous, cover, and let sit 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork.
Stir in the lemon juice, zest, olive oil, and herbs.
Season with salt and serve warm or at room temperature.

recipeCards.title: Lemon Poppy Loaf
recipeCards.flavorText: A sunny loaf cake with soft icing and poppy-speckled crumb.

steps: Cream the butter and sugar, then beat in the eggs, lemon zest, and juice.
Fold in the flour, baking powder, and poppy seeds.
Pour into a loaf pan and bake at 350°F (175°C) until a toothpick comes out clean, about 50 minutes.

recipeCards.title: Lemon Skillet Greens
recipeCards.flavorText: Skillet greens with a bright citrus lift.

steps: Warm the olive oil and cook the garlic until fragrant.
Add the greens and cook until just wilted.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon juice and season to taste.

recipeCards.title: Lemon Thyme Biscuits
recipeCards.flavorText: Warm biscuits glossed with lemon and dotted with thyme.

steps: Mix the flour, baking powder, lemon zest, and thyme.
Cut in the cold butter until crumbly, then stir in the buttermilk just until combined.
Pat into a round, cut into biscuits, and bake at 425°F (220°C) until golden, about 15 minutes.

recipeCards.title: Pantry Bean Stew
recipeCards.flavorText: A humble pantry stew that still feels hearty and rich.

steps: Sauté the onion and garlic until soft.
Add the beans, tomatoes, and broth.
Simmer for 20 minutes, mashing some of the beans to thicken.
Season to taste and serve hot.

recipeCards.title: Roasted Garlic Mash
recipeCards.flavorText: Creamy mash with deep roasted garlic warmth.

steps: Cut the top off the garlic head, drizzle with olive oil, wrap in foil, and roast at 400°F (200°C) for 40 minutes until soft.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then drain.
Squeeze the roasted garlic cloves from their skins.
Mash the potatoes with the garlic, butter, and warm milk.
Season to taste.

recipeCards.title: Roasted Garlic Soup
recipeCards.flavorText: Smooth soup with mellow garlic sweetness.

steps: Cut the tops off the garlic heads, drizzle with olive oil, wrap in foil, and roast at 400°F (200°C) for 40 minutes until soft.
Sauté the onion in butter until soft.
Squeeze in the roasted garlic and add the broth.
Simmer 15 minutes, then blend until smooth.
Stir in a splash of cream and season to taste.

recipeCards.title: Roasted Pepper Stew
recipeCards.flavorText: A pepper-rich stew that glows with slow-cooked comfort.

steps: Sauté the onion and garlic until soft.
Add the roasted peppers, tomatoes, and broth.
Simmer for 25 minutes, then blend partially for a rustic texture.
Season to taste and serve warm.

recipeCards.title: Rosemary Garlic Rolls
recipeCards.flavorText: Golden rolls brushed with rosemary-garlic butter.

steps: Mix the flour, yeast, salt, sugar, and warm water into a soft dough and let rise until doubled.
Divide into rolls and place in a buttered pan.
Brush with garlic butter and top with rosemary before baking at 375°F (190°C) until golden.

recipeCards.title: Skillet Lemon Potatoes
recipeCards.flavorText: Crisp-edged potatoes with cheerful lemon brightness.

steps: Cook the potatoes cut-side down in olive oil until deeply golden.
Add the garlic and cook until fragrant.
Finish with lemon zest, juice, and fresh herbs before serving.

recipeCards.title: Spoon Cake Pudding
recipeCards.flavorText: A soft spoonable dessert with warm bakery comfort.

steps: Whisk all the ingredients together into a smooth batter.
Pour into a baking dish.
Bake at 350°F (175°C) until the top is set and the center stays soft, about 30 minutes.
Serve warm, straight from the dish, by the spoonful.

recipeCards.title: Spoon-Stirred Polenta
recipeCards.flavorText: Golden polenta stirred smooth and finished warm.

steps: Bring the broth to a simmer and slowly whisk in the polenta.
Stir often over low heat until thick and creamy, about 20 minutes.
Stir in the butter and cheese.
Season to taste and serve warm.

recipeCards.title: Sunday Herb Stuffing
recipeCards.flavorText: Toasty bread-cube stuffing made for a full family table.

ingredients: A handful of fresh herbs, chopped
steps: Sauté the onion and celery in butter until soft.
Toss with the bread cubes, herbs, and broth until evenly moistened.
Transfer to a baking dish and bake at 350°F (175°C) until golden on top, about 35 minutes.

recipeCards.title: Tomato Basil Tart
recipeCards.flavorText: A bright tomato tart with basil leaves like little jewels.

ingredients: 3 ripe tomatoes, sliced and lightly salted to drain
steps: Lay the tomato slices on paper towels, salt lightly, and let sit 10 minutes to draw out extra moisture.
Roll out the pastry and score a border, then prick the center all over.
Sprinkle with cheese, then layer on the tomato slices.
Drizzle with olive oil and bake at 400°F (200°C) until golden, about 25 minutes.
Scatter with fresh basil before serving.

recipeCards.title: Tomato Braised Beans
recipeCards.flavorText: Beans simmered low in a rich tomato base.

steps: Sauté the onion and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Add the beans and tomatoes.
Simmer low and slow for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season to taste and serve warm.

recipeCards.title: Tomato Harvest Pie
recipeCards.flavorText: A harvest-style savory pie built around ripe tomatoes.

steps: Blind-bake the pie crust until lightly golden.
Layer in the tomato slices, seasoning as you go.
Mix the cheese and mayonnaise and spread over the top.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) until bubbling and golden, about 30 minutes.

recipeCards.title: Tomato Jam Toast
recipeCards.flavorText: Sweet-savory tomato jam spread over rustic toast.

steps: Simmer the tomatoes, sugar, and vinegar together until thick and jammy, about 25 minutes.
Let cool slightly.
Spread the toast with soft cheese and top generously with the tomato jam.

recipeCards.title: Tomato Rice Bake
recipeCards.flavorText: A casserole-style rice bake with baked tomato comfort.

steps: Sauté the onion until soft, then stir in the rice, tomatoes, and broth.
Pour into a baking dish and cover.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) until the rice is tender, about 40 minutes.
Top with cheese and bake uncovered until melted.

recipeCards.title: Garden Tomato Galette
recipeCards.flavorText: Rustic free-form pastry hugging a circle of tomatoes.

steps: Roll out the pie crust on a baking sheet.
Spread the cheese in the center, leaving a wide border, then layer on the tomatoes.
Fold the edges of the crust up and over, brushing with egg wash.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) until golden, about 30 minutes, and finish with fresh herbs.

recipeCards.title: Basil Skillet Bread
recipeCards.flavorText: Round skillet bread with basil baked right into the top.

ingredients: A handful of fresh basil, chopped
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, water, olive oil, and salt into a soft dough and let rise until doubled.
Press into a hot, oiled skillet and scatter the basil over the top.
Bake at 425°F (220°C) until golden, about 20 minutes.

recipeCards.title: Skillet Honey Squash
recipeCards.flavorText: Honey-glossed squash with cozy autumn warmth.

ingredients: 1 small delicata squash, sliced into rounds (no need to peel)
steps: Cook the squash slices in butter over medium heat until tender and lightly browned.
Drizzle with honey and a pinch of cinnamon.
Season with a little salt and serve warm.
